title: Domain steel profile section and factory

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root public exports for the migrated steel profile section class and factory

sourceOracles.coverage: Steel profile construction, unit conversion, overrides, catalog family behavior and unsupported profile errors

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript steel profile section and factory modules, including CrossSection inheritance isolation, exact serialized and enumerable-property parity, catalog conversion, override conversion, Unicode metadata, factory delegation and unsupported-input error parity.

tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for converted section properties and catalog data
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality
tolerances.errors: exact error name and message equality

parityDifferences: The strict TypeScript declarations describe the existing JavaScript steel profile section and factory contract without adding runtime behavior.
The class uses null-preserving strict declarations for inherited section fields; runtime property initialization and serialization remain source-compatible.
engineeringFunctionality: Solver-neutral steel profile cross-section construction from the pinned catalog, internal-unit conversion, explicit property overrides, section metadata and serialization.
